Name: agreements
Description: Number of contract chains (one original agreement plus all its amendments = one closed deal). The grain of every reconciliation question.

Name: active_agreements
Description: Agreements whose current end date is on or after the as-of date 2026-09-30.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_CONTRACT_CHAIN.IS_ACTIVE_TODAY THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: amended_agreements
Description: Agreements with at least one signed amendment.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_CONTRACT_CHAIN.AMENDMENT_COUNT > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: amendments_signed
Description: Total number of amendments signed across all agreements.

Name: contract_tcv
Description: Total contract value per the latest signed document of each agreement (the legal truth). Sum across agreements.

Name: salesforce_booked
Description: Salesforce value of the agreements: the sum of closed-won opportunity amounts (original plus amendment increments).

Name: netsuite_ordered
Description: NetSuite value of the agreements: the sum of sales order totals linked to each agreement.

Name: salesforce_net_variance
Description: Salesforce booked minus contract TCV (positive = Salesforce overstates). Net figure; use the TCV_MISMATCH check for per-agreement findings.

Name: netsuite_net_variance
Description: NetSuite ordered minus contract TCV (negative = NetSuite has not caught up with amendments; positive = duplicate orders).

Name: agreements_with_tcv_variance
Description: Agreements where Salesforce bookings differ from the contract TCV by more than 100 USD (the TCV_MISMATCH check).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(COALESCE(V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.SF_AMOUNT, 0) - V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.CURRENT_TCV) > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: agreements_netsuite_behind_amendment
Description: Amended agreements whose last Boomi sync precedes the latest amendment signature (the AMENDMENT_NOT_IN_NETSUITE check).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.AMENDMENT_COUNT > 0 AND COALESCE(V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.NS_VERSION_REFLECTED, 0) < V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.LATEST_VERSION THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: agreements_salesforce_behind_amendment
Description: Amended agreements where no opportunity references the latest amendment (the AMENDMENT_NOT_IN_SALESFORCE check).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.AMENDMENT_COUNT > 0 AND COALESCE(V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.SF_VERSION_REFLECTED, 0) < V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.LATEST_VERSION THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: agreements_with_end_date_variance
Description: Agreements whose NetSuite service end date differs from the contract end date (the TERM_END_DATE_MISMATCH check).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.NS_END_DATE <> V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.CURRENT_END_DATE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: agreements_with_payment_terms_variance
Description: Agreements whose NetSuite payment terms differ from the contract (the PAYMENT_TERMS_MISMATCH check).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.NS_PAYMENT_TERMS <> V_CHAIN_SYSTEM_SUMMARY.CURRENT_PAYMENT_TERMS THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: agreements_with_billing_frequency_variance
Description: Agreements whose NetSuite billing schedule type differs from the contract billing frequency (the BILLING_FREQUENCY_MISMATCH check).

Name: agreements_with_duplicate_orders
Description: Agreements mapped to more than one NetSuite sales order (the DUPLICATE_SALES_ORDERS check).

Name: netsuite_orders_without_opportunity
Description: NetSuite sales orders with no Salesforce opportunity id (the SALES_ORDER_WITHOUT_OPPORTUNITY check).
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN NETSUITE_SALES_ORDERS.OPPORTUNITY_ID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: opportunities_without_contract_number
Description: Closed-won opportunities with a blank linked contract number.
SQL: SUM(CASE WHEN SALESFORCE_OPPORTUNITIES.LINKED_CONTRACT_NUMBER IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

Name: contract_milestones_scheduled
Description: Total scheduled amount across contract billing schedules (Exhibit B of every signed document; use the latest document of each agreement for the current schedule).

Name: netsuite_billed_to_date
Description: Amount NetSuite has invoiced to date across the agreements.

Name: netsuite_scheduled_billing
Description: Total NetSuite billing schedule amount across the agreements.

Name: documents_signed
Description: Signed documents extracted from DocuSign (originals plus amendments).

Name: average_extraction_confidence
Description: Average confidence of the contract term extraction; below 0.90 the document was reviewed by Deal Desk.

Name: opportunities_closed_won
Description: Closed-won opportunities replicated from Salesforce.

Name: bookings
Description: Sum of closed-won opportunity amounts (increments for amendments).

Name: sales_orders
Description: NetSuite sales orders.

Name: tcv_change_from_amendments
Description: Net change in contract value introduced by amendments (sum of tcv_change over amendment versions).
